description: A chatbot answers. A Bolt does the work. Bolts are AI employees you hire for a real job: research a market, find leads, watch competitor prices, draft outreach. Each Bolt has its own cloud computer, so it can open websites, use the apps you sign it into, and keep working even when your laptop is off. You brief the job in plain English, or pick a ready-made Bolt from the marketplace. It plans the work, gathers sources, and brings you a result to review. A shared Business Brain remembers your product, tone, customers and rules, so every Bolt stays consistent. Nothing goes out on its own. Before a Bolt sends a message, publishes a post, makes a payment or deletes anything, it asks for your approval. Bolts is the AI-employees product from BuildItOmi. Plans are in US dollars worldwide: Lite $19, Bolts $49, Pro $149 and Max $299 per month. Lite, Bolts and Pro include a 30-minute trial of real work. A card is required. Cancel in the app before the 30 minutes end and you are not charged.
